page.layout: One text column with a running head at the top and the printed page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A heading block, then verse stanzas in full lines, with a large initial S at the start of the verse block.

p.i: Hunc tibi, Beza, dicat, gratum hunc tibi, Beza, laborem
Sic Philomela meu Virgulta per omnia Bezam,
Per memora & dumos, perq; umbriferas conualles
Et canat, & lugo resonet mihi carmine Bezam.

main_text.head: HIC QVOQVE, CHRISTIANE Lector, fas sit adiungere eiusdem doctissimi, optimique viri, Ioannis Tagauti, aliud carmen, sempiterna memoria dignum: quod historiae Gallorum Martyrum sub Voti nomine nuncupauit.
main_text.p:
Sancte audi: sancto facilis, precor, annue Voto,
Magne opifex, cuius non enarrabile nomen,
Et cælum, ac miseri confusa potentia regni
Lucifugum, & mundi bruta hæc elementa tremiscunt:

p.i: Quem Natura tremit Generans, Sltroq; fatetur
Te Rege Auctoremque suum, qui numine cœplet
Omnia: Regem Sno quo iudice stant & cadúntque
Res hominum, morbo iaceant, seu luce fruantur:
Seu bellum pacemue feras & gaudia vita.
Aspicis ut Babylon Pacem tot poscat ab armis
impia, & interea cæco ruat acta furore.

page.notes: Several line ends are cut or faint at the left and right edges of the scan, and the initial S is partly obscured; readings such as "Sancte"/"Sanfte", "Sltroq;" and "Sno quo" are doubtful and have not been marked individually. The first verse line of the opening stanza is cut at the left edge. The heading is set in roman capitals with a long rule above it.
